story.what_it_does: IGI certifies diamonds, lab-grown diamonds and gemstones by grading them and issuing reports, and earns most of its revenue from certification fees. In the 15 months to March 2026 it earned INR 15,976 million of consolidated revenue and INR 7,112 million of profit after tax, with an EBITDA margin of about 61%.
story.plans: Management guided to 15% revenue growth and 20% EBITDA growth for FY27, and said in the June 2026 call that it would maintain both. In the September 2026 call it only said it expects to outperform, and gave no new numeric target.
story.moat: The notes say IGI is a large independent certifier, with a market share figure of 50% in one press release and demand for independent certification said to be rising. Margins of around 60% suggest strong operating leverage, but the notes also flag competition from established global labs and a large retailer launching its own lab-grown brand using its own certification.

scenarios.story: Q2 FY27 was reported as the best quarter ever, with revenue up 31% and profit after tax up 43% on 26% volume growth. If this pace holds and lab-grown adoption keeps rising, results could beat the FY27 guidance.

Whether management raises the FY27 guidance of 15% revenue growth and 20% EBITDA growth
